decisionModel: Only verified direct receipts or class-authenticated references establish fetch inputs; lifecycle, exact bytes, authority, timeliness, absence, and equivocation remain separate fail-closed gates.
hashRecipe: sha256(compact sorted-key UTF-8 JSON of vectors)

vectors.name: direct-finalized-receipt-resolves
vectors.reason: a verified finalized direct receipt authorizes the exact fetch-and-hash path

vectors.name: vet-accepted-permits-reversible-progress
vectors.reason: the DACS-2 calling rule may select verified durable accepted for a reversible gate

vectors.name: accepted-cannot-satisfy-finalized-gate
vectors.reason: a lower lifecycle observation cannot promote itself to the caller's finalized gate

vectors.name: bare-native-locator-is-not-resolution
vectors.reason: a locator without an authenticated carrier does not establish the mapping

vectors.name: unverified-receipt-is-discarded
vectors.reason: receipt fields are assertions until substrate evidence verifies

vectors.name: malformed-number-transaction-ref-is-discarded
vectors.reason: a numeric transactionRef is malformed and the receipt is discarded

vectors.name: unhashable-native-address-is-discarded
vectors.reason: a non-string nativeAddress is malformed and cannot reach storage lookup

vectors.name: non-numeric-delivery-time-is-discarded
vectors.reason: a non-numeric carrier delivery time cannot satisfy the receipt-delivery gate

vectors.name: unauthenticated-catalog-assertion-is-discarded
vectors.reason: an ordinary catalog assertion is not a portable mapping carrier

vectors.name: unauthenticated-index-assertion-is-discarded
vectors.reason: an ordinary index assertion is not a portable mapping carrier

vectors.name: missing-receipt-remains-indeterminate
vectors.reason: non-delivery is not authoritative absence

vectors.name: receipt-logical-address-substitution
vectors.reason: a logical address mutation invalidates the authenticated SR2-5 tuple

vectors.name: receipt-native-address-substitution
vectors.reason: a native address mutation invalidates the authenticated SR2-5 tuple

vectors.name: receipt-content-hash-substitution
vectors.reason: a content hash mutation invalidates the authenticated SR2-5 tuple

vectors.name: receipt-transaction-ref-substitution
vectors.reason: a transaction ref mutation invalidates the authenticated SR2-5 tuple

vectors.name: receipt-writer-substitution
vectors.reason: a writer mutation invalidates the authenticated SR2-5 tuple

vectors.name: receipt-nonce-substitution
vectors.reason: a nonce mutation invalidates the authenticated SR2-5 tuple

vectors.name: artifact-authority-is-a-separate-gate
vectors.reason: valid storage proof does not authorize the writer for this logical artifact

vectors.name: fetched-content-hash-mismatch
vectors.reason: returned bytes that do not match the verified receipt are not accepted

vectors.name: receipt-delivered-after-first-gate
vectors.reason: late delivery is a producer conformance failure and cannot validate prior progress retroactively

vectors.name: aborted-session-still-requires-retained-receipt
vectors.reason: an aborted session without a bundle does not waive direct receipt retention

vectors.name: finalized-bundle-reference-dereferences
vectors.reason: an authenticated finalized-bundle reference may carry an exact locator and hash

vectors.name: authenticated-registry-index-reference-dereferences
vectors.reason: a verified immutable registry snapshot may carry an exact definition reference

vectors.name: unauthenticated-reference-does-not-dereference
vectors.reason: content hash and locator alone do not authenticate a transitive reference

vectors.name: unrecognized-authenticated-reference-surface-is-discarded
vectors.reason: an authenticated-reference tag cannot invent a third SR2-10 discovery surface

vectors.name: two-unequal-authorized-carriers-are-a-fork
vectors.reason: arrival order cannot select between unequal qualifying immutable mappings

vectors.name: ordinary-not-found-is-not-absence
vectors.reason: an unqualified no-content response remains indeterminate

vectors.name: declared-authenticated-absence-policy-can-establish-absence
vectors.reason: a binding-defined finalized authenticated absence policy may establish absence

vectors.name: authenticated-presence-and-absence-conflict
vectors.reason: conflicting authenticated positive and negative state views cannot select a winner

vectors.name: ordinary-absence-claim-cannot-override-presence
vectors.reason: an unauthenticated absence claim is ignored when a qualifying receipt resolves

vectors.name: equivalent-reference-and-receipt-collapse
vectors.reason: two carrier classes resolving the same artifact are retained but are not a fork

vectors.name: observer-time-and-index-visibility-do-not-choose-a-fork
vectors.reason: observedAt and index visibility are not authenticated ordering inputs
